tools.name: read_section
tools.description:
Read a page found by search_docs.

Without a heading: the page's description and outline (top-level sections
with subsection counts). With a heading: that section's full text,
including its subsections; continue long sections with next_offset.
outline_depth=3 also lists subsections; use it only on l

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_docs" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the official documentation of Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex and MCP. Use it before answering any question about using, configuring or administering t…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
